title: Program Premiums on the Mortgage Loan File: Upfront Fee and Annual Premium Rates
content:
Two Mortgage Loan File programs carry a government program premium: an upfront program fee that is financed into the loan (the FHA upfront mortgage insurance premium or the VA funding fee) and, for FHA, an annual premium. The rates below are set per program.

| Program | Upfront program fee (percent of the base loan amount) | Annual program premium (percent of the average outstanding balance) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 1.750% | 0.550% |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 2.150% | 0.000% |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 0.000% |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 0.000% |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 0.000% |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 0.000% |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 0.000% |

Both rates are percentages stated to 3 decimals. The upfront rate applies to the base loan amount; the annual rate applies to the average outstanding balance.

**Rate notes**

1. Under the Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed program the upfront premium is 1.750% of the base loan amount and the annual premium is 0.550% of the average outstanding balance.
2. Under the Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed program the funding fee is 2.150% of the base loan amount; the program carries no annual premium.
3. The remaining five programs carry neither an upfront fee nor an annual premium (0.000%).

Hypothetical illustration: on a Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed file with a base loan amount of 200000.00 USD, the upfront premium rate of 1.750% corresponds to 3500.00 USD.
